hero.h1: Where real businesses find new owners.
hero.subBold: Service companies, small manufacturing, tourism & hospitality businesses.
hero.subRest: Not startups, not crypto. We give your business the presentation it needs to find the right buyer.

problem.sellersQuote: I know every corner of this business. I just don't know where to start when it comes to selling it.
problem.response1: The businesses Bottega lists aren't speculative.
problem.response2: They have cash flow, they're proven, and they're founder-run.
problem.response3: Their challenge isn't viability: it's transition.
problem.brokersQuote: I spend more time explaining the business than selling it.
problem.buyersQuote: Half the listings I look at don't have enough information to take a first step.

how.heading: How it works
how.step1Desc: Tell us about your business in 4 short steps. No jargon. No accountant required.
how.step2Desc: Bottega writes your deal page: clear, professional, buyer-ready.
how.step3Desc: Serious enquiries come through Bottega. You decide who to engage.
how.reassurance: Free to start. No commitment until you're ready.

why.heading: Built for businesses that don't need a pitch deck.
why.prose1: Most deal platforms are designed for startups: high-growth companies raising money, burning cash, betting on a future. Bottega is built for the opposite: businesses with cash flow, real clients, and years behind them.
why.prose2: These businesses don't need hype. They need a clear presentation: financials framed properly, story told well, so the right buyer can recognise what they're looking at. That's what Bottega does.
why.stat1Label: The only platform focused on these two markets
why.stat2Label: We curate and review every deal page, not an algorithm
why.stat3Label: Financials and sensitive info protected until you decide to share

brokers.heading: For brokers and M&A advisors
brokers.body: If you represent sellers, Bottega gives your deals a better home.

cta.heading: Your business deserves a proper presentation. Start here.
cta.sub: Free to start. No broker fees. No exclusivity.

hero.h1: You built it. We'll help you find continuity.
hero.sub: Bottega turns your business information into a structured deal page and puts it in front of buyers actively looking in Italy and Portugal. Free to start, no broker fees.
hero.supporting: Takes 10 minutes. No commitment until you're ready.

problem.heading: Selling a business is hard when you've never done it before.
problem.card1Body: You know your business inside out. But explaining it to an outside buyer (its financials, its strengths, its potential) is a different skill entirely.
problem.card2Body: Serious buyers exist. But they don't browse classifieds. They rely on curated sources, trusted advisors, and platforms that do the screening for them.
problem.card3Body: You don't want your competitors knowing you're selling. You don't want tyre-kickers calling your staff. You want control.

whatYouGet.heading: Here's what you get.
whatYouGet.free1: Your business listed on Bottega, Italy and Portugal's only curated SME deal platform
whatYouGet.free2: A structured deal page (we write the copy based on your inputs)
whatYouGet.free3: A public teaser to attract serious interest
whatYouGet.free4: Full financials stay private until a buyer signs a confidentiality agreement
whatYouGet.free5: Up to 10 inbound enquiries routed through Bottega marketplace
whatYouGet.assisted2: A professional deal teaser document, yours to use anywhere, not just on Bottega
whatYouGet.assisted3: NDA support, we handle the paperwork
whatYouGet.assisted4: Outreach materials you can use in your own network, independently of Bottega
whatYouGet.assisted6: Strategic insights, buyer profiles, angles to lead with, what to address upfront with buyers
whatYouGet.assisted7: Curated, one-off buyer matching, we reach out to relevant buyers in our network
whatYouGet.assisted8: Unlimited inbound enquiries through Bottega marketplace
whatYouGet.assistedCta: Talk to us about the Assisted plan →
whatYouGet.whiteGloveBody: Full advisory support from positioning to close. For owners who want a hands-off experience and complete guidance through the process.

privacy.heading: Nothing goes out without your say-so.
privacy.prose1: Your deal page shows buyers enough to assess whether to take the conversation further: sector, location, headline metrics, and a description of your business. That's it.
privacy.prose2: Your financials, your business name, your contact details: none of this is shared until a buyer signs a confidentiality agreement and you've decided to proceed. You're in control of every step.
privacy.protected2: Business name (unless you choose to show it)

howItWorks.heading: From form to live listing in days, not months.
howItWorks.step1Desc: A 4-step guided form. No jargon. Takes about 10 minutes.
howItWorks.step2Label: We review and write your listing
howItWorks.step2Desc: Bottega writes the deal description based on your inputs. We may follow up with a short call to fill gaps.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Published on Bottega, visible to buyers browsing Italy and Portugal.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Buyers reach out via Bottega. We review and route to you. You decide who to engage.
howItWorks.reassurance: No brokers. No exclusivity. No upfront costs on the free plan. You can withdraw your listing at any time.

cta.heading: Ready to find out what your business is worth to the right buyer?
cta.supporting: Free to start. No exclusivity. Cancel anytime.

hero.sub: Bottega gives your deals a structured home: a professional deal page that buyers can evaluate properly. You keep the client relationship. We handle presentation and inbound.

problem.heading: Most deal presentations don't do justice to the business.
problem.prose:
A PDF sent cold. A Dropbox link with unstructured financials. A listing on a classifieds site with three lines of description. Buyers scroll past. Conversations never start.

You've done the work to represent the seller. Bottega makes sure buyers can see it.

features.heading: A deal page your clients will be proud of.
features.feat1Desc: Every listing gets a clean, professional page: sector, location, headline metrics, description, highlights. Buyers get enough to self-qualify before requesting more.
features.feat2Desc: Full financial detail stays protected. Buyers who want to go further submit an enquiry. You're notified and in control of what gets shared.
features.feat3Desc: Enquiries from interested buyers come through Bottega and route directly to you. No cold calls to your client. No broker bypassing.
features.feat4Desc: Each deal gets a clean URL you can share in your own outreach. Works as your deal summary, not a replacement for your process.

notABroker.heading: We present deals. We don't compete for them.
notABroker.prose1: Bottega doesn't take success fees on broker-submitted deals. We're not a competing advisor. We're presentation infrastructure: the professional front-end your listings deserve.
notABroker.prose2: You own the client relationship. You manage the process. We make your listing look like it deserves serious attention.

pricing.heading: Free to start. No setup required.
pricing.free2: Full deal page per listing written by Bottega
pricing.pro2: Branded listing pages (your logo and firm name)
pricing.reassurance: Free tier covers everything you need to get started. No credit card. No calls to book. Just post your deal.

founding.heading: Helping shape what Bottega builds for advisors.
founding.prose: We're working with a small group of brokers in Italy and Portugal to understand what actually matters, before we build it. If you work deals in this market, we'd like to talk.

hero.h1: Curated SME deals in Italy and Portugal.
hero.sub: Bottega lists curated acquisition opportunities: manufacturing, professional services, food & beverage, specialty businesses. Every deal reviewed. Every listing curated to help you evaluate quickly.
hero.ctaSecondary: Talk to us about what you're looking for →

problem.heading: Buying a small business takes longer than it should.
problem.prose1: Finding a quality deal is hard enough. When you do find one, you spend weeks chasing the seller for documentation. Then more weeks finding the right lawyer, the right accountant. Professionals who actually know SME transactions in this market.
problem.prose2: And sometimes, after months of effort and real money spent, the business simply wasn't worth buying.
problem.prose3: That's the reality most buyers face in Southern Europe. Bottega is built to change it.
problem.pain1Quote: Three months and nothing to show for it.
problem.pain1Desc: Time lost chasing documentation, assembling professionals, running due diligence, only to walk away.
problem.pain2Quote: The listing had three lines and a phone number.
problem.pain2Desc: Most publicly listed deals in Italy and Portugal are poorly presented. Revenue figures with no context. Brokers who don't respond.
problem.pain3Quote: I didn't even know what I didn't know.
problem.pain3Desc: Finding the right legal and financial professionals for an SME acquisition in a foreign market is its own project.

features.heading: Deals you can evaluate quickly, before you commit your time.
features.feat1Desc: Every listing has a written description, headline financial metrics, and clear context, authored by Bottega, not copy-pasted from the seller. You can self-qualify in minutes, not weeks.
features.feat2Desc: Full financial detail is available after an initial conversation. We protect sellers, which means the numbers you eventually see are real, not sanitised.
features.feat3Desc: Express interest through the platform. No cold calls, no broker gatekeeping. Bottega routes your enquiry and follows up directly.
features.feat4Desc: We source deals directly from founders: manufacturing clusters in northern Italy, service businesses in Lisbon and Porto, food producers across both countries. Markets most platforms underserve.

access.heading: Free to browse. Free to enquire.
access.prose: No paywalls. No account required to browse. Register with your name and email when you're ready to enquire. That's it.

founding.heading: Helping us build what buyers actually need.
founding.prose1: We're at an early stage, and we'd rather talk to serious buyers than guess what to build. If you're actively looking for acquisition opportunities in Italy or Portugal, we'd like to understand your process, your pain, and what would actually help.
founding.prose2: In exchange, you'll shape what Bottega builds for buyers and get early access to features as they launch.

s1.heading: 1. About Bottega
s1.body: Bottega Ventures Ltd ("Bottega", "we", "us") operates a curated deal platform connecting SME owners ("Sellers") with prospective acquirers ("Buyers") and deal intermediaries ("Brokers"). By accessing or using the Bottega platform, you agree to these Terms.

s2.heading: 2. Not a broker or financial adviser
s2.body: Bottega is a platform operator, not a licensed business broker, financial adviser, or legal adviser. We do not represent either party in any transaction. Nothing on this platform constitutes financial, legal, or investment advice. All parties should seek independent professional advice before entering any transaction.

s3.heading: 3. Eligibility
s3.body: You must be at least 18 years old and legally capable of entering binding agreements to use this platform. By using Bottega, you confirm this.

s4.heading: 4. Seller terms
s4.intro: By submitting your business to Bottega, you confirm that:
s4.item1: You are authorised to represent and sell the business in question
s4.item2: All information provided is accurate, complete, and not misleading to the best of your knowledge
s4.item3: You will notify us promptly of any material changes to the information submitted
s4.item4: You consent to your anonymised deal information being shared with vetted buyers and brokers on the platform
s4.discretion: Bottega reserves the right to decline, remove, or unpublish any listing at its sole discretion.

s5.heading: 5. Buyer terms
s5.intro: By accessing deal information on Bottega, you agree to:
s5.item1: Use deal information solely for the purpose of evaluating a potential acquisition
s5.item2: Treat all non-public business information as confidential
s5.item3: Not contact sellers or third parties connected to a listing outside of the Bottega-facilitated process without our consent
s5.item4: Not share deal materials with third parties without our prior written consent

s6.heading: 6. Broker terms
s6.intro: Brokers accessing the platform agree to the Buyer Terms above, and additionally:
s6.item1: Represent only parties whose interests do not conflict with those of Bottega users

s7.heading: 7. Accuracy of information
s7.body: Bottega does not verify the accuracy of information submitted by Sellers. Buyers and Brokers are responsible for conducting their own due diligence. Bottega accepts no liability for decisions made based on platform content.

s8.heading: 8. Intellectual property
s8.body: All platform content, branding, and materials produced by Bottega remain the intellectual property of Bottega Ventures Ltd. User-submitted content remains the property of the submitting party, but you grant Bottega a licence to use it for platform operations.

s9.heading: 9. Limitation of liability

s9.item1: Bottega is not liable for the failure of any transaction introduced through the platform
s9.item2: Bottega is not liable for any loss arising from reliance on information provided by Sellers, Buyers, or Brokers

s10.heading: 10. Termination
s10.body: Bottega may suspend or terminate your access at any time for breach of these Terms, misuse of the platform, or at our sole discretion. You may stop using the platform at any time.

s11.heading: 11. Governing law
